thread:
maria_sales: Orchid Systems legal requested SOC2 excerpts + ISO scope snippet, a signed pen-test letter, and confirmation we can retain API request logs for 90 days during their 30-day POC. Theyre deciding Hosted vs Dedicated and want clarity on any onboarding fees.

devin_pre_sales: Short checklist: SOC2 summary (redacted), controls-matrix.csv, ISO27001 scope excerpt, pen-test attestation (one-page), network diagram, and a one-paragraph procurement note. Can we assemble a single package?

sara_security: We have a standard packet. Pen-test attestation is a one-page letter stating a third-party external test within last 12 months and current remediation status. Full vuln reports require NDA. Hosted default logs = 30d; 90d is available via addendum or Dedicated with log addon.

maria_sales: Orchid insists 90d for the POC to satisfy their audit reviewers. Any way to enable 90d temporarily on Hosted for a trial?

sara_security: We can enable 90d for Hosted by signing an MSA amendment and turning on the logging add-on. Legal needs to sign; timeline is same-day once NDA/MSA is agreed. For Dedicated, 90d is a configurable retention via the Dedicated contract.

ops_infra: Cost note: Hosted trial + credits = no onboarding fee. Dedicated POC requires minimal reserved capacity and networking/KMS setup. Typical small-pool setup runs ~$3k one-time + usage. Egress billed per cloud provider. If they request IP allowlist or VPC peering, schedule a short maintenance window.

devin_pre_sales: We should ask Orchid for expected RPS and average generation lengths so I can produce a Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta. If they cant, use conservative defaults (5 concurrent, avg 512 tokens).

maria_sales: They also want staging access for SAML SSO tests and an evidence upload method. They prefer SFTP but infra asked for presigned S3.

ops_infra: We recommend presigned S3 uploads with scoped IAM; we can provide managed SFTP on request but its manual. Example presign: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-stage/orchid/poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 172800`. We'll attach a manifest (SHA256) and lifecycle to auto-delete after 7 days.

sara_security: For non-repudiation we watermark PDFs and include a signed manifest file: `sha256sum acme_poc_evidence/* > manifest.sha256`. We'll state in the packet: "Files delivered hashed and signed by Redwood Security; full reports provided under NDA."

artifact-bot: Uploaded "orchid_poc/1770000001/" (5 files) -- https://storage.internal/redwood/orchid_poc/1770000001

maria_sales: Please prefill the pen-test attestation and mark vendor/date fields for legal. Also draft the procurement blurb answering: onboarding fee, 90d for POC, egress commitments, and which artifacts need NDA. I'll send to Orchid and propose a call tomorrow 10am PT.

devin_pre_sales: I'll produce the delta table and short email draft by EOD.

sara_security: ETA for prefilled attestation: 3 hours. I'll include the line: "Redwood Inference attests to an external penetration test performed on [DATE] by [VENDOR]; summary attached; full report available under NDA."

ops_infra: Adding a note for procurement: "One-time Dedicated onboarding (networking/KMS) typically $2k-$5k depending on cross-account networking. Egress billed per cloud rates; Dedicated does not change carrier egress pricing."

maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll follow up after the call.
